Company Description

About Redcare Pharmacy:
As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy, Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy, collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values, join us and begin your #Redcareer today.
About the role:
Join our team as a Warehouse Worker (m/f/d) and shape the future of healthcare logistics and earn ca. 1077€ net amount per month for 20h/ week.
Working Hours: You work from Monday till Friday from 6-10 p.m. (18 - 22 o'clock).
Job Description

About your tasks: ✓ You will handle incoming goods and store all incoming products, distributing them appropriately in our warehouse✓ You will precisely pick our products, ensuring the complete processing of customer orders ✓ You will carefully pack customer orders and guarantee a smooth shipping✓
You carry out regular quality checks and ensure that damaged or faulty products are identified and removed at an early stage✓
You keep your work area organized and clean, contributing to a safe and efficient warehouse environment

Qualifications

About you:  ✓ You are an EU citizen or hold a Dutch work permit ✓ You can understand and speak German or English without difficulty ✓ You have a driver’s license and a car or motorcycle, etc., to commute independently to the workplace in Sevenum (Note: There is no public transport connection) ✓ You are able to perform a standing job for up to 8 hours a day and walk more than 15,000 steps ✓ You don’t need years of warehouse experience, as long as you are willing to learn new tasks

Additional Information

About our benefits:
In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs – whether it’s living a healthy life, having enough time for your needs, or developing your skills – we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:     ✓ Mobility: Not all employees live close to our office. That’s why we support our employees with your daily commute with a travel allowance. This compensation is paid to you in addition to your salary.  ✓ Redcare events: We promote team-building through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.  ✓ Vacation: We can offer you 28 vacation days and a vacation pay once per year (8 % of your annual gross) in addition to your salary.  ✓ Employee discount: Several times a year, we offer you discounted employee sales directly at the Sevenum location as well as 10 % off on our assortment for all employees.  ✓ Employee referral program: Because our employees know best who fits in with us, successful recommendations are rewarded with a bonus.

jobs.occupation: Senior Steel Trader (all genders welcome) Global Cross Trading (Leiter/in - Export)
jobs.description:
Company

Operating on a global scale through an international sales and distribution network, tk accelis Trading, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, is your partner for long-term success. With our local contacts around the world we are represented where the customers need us. Our core capabilities embrace complex logistic services for raw and finished steel materials along with supply chain dependability and consultancy for the downstream manufacturing and metalworking industries.

Your responsibilities

Build and scale profitable physical steel trading flows, with particular emphasis on cross-border and third-country trading. Sales market focus is EMEA. We are open to candidates trading steel products, including flat products, long products, semi-finished products, or finished goods (steel derivates). More important than a specific product background is a demonstrable ability to originate repeatable, profitable international trade flows.

- Leverage in-depth commercial and technical knowledge of steel products and specifications to support profitable trading activities.
- Identify, establish, and expand sourcing opportunities and supplier relationships across global markets.
- Build, maintain, and strengthen long-term relationships with customers and suppliers on a national and international level.
- Manage the full trading cycle, including origination, pricing, negotiation, contracting, execution, receivables management, and PundL accountability.
- Develop new procurement and sales channels to drive business growth and increase market penetration.
- Collaborate effectively within a multinational environment while utilizing a strong regional and international network to expand business opportunities.
- Develop and manage a trading book to achieve agreed volume, gross margin, EBIT, working capital, and risk targets.

Your profile

- 8+ years of proven experience in physical steel trading with a strong track record of commercial success.
- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, combined with a confident and professional presence.
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to drive business growth while operating within corporate governance frameworks.
- Strong risk assessment capabilities to support profitable trading decisions.
- High level of integrity and thorough understanding of compliance, sanctions, competition law, and reputational risk considerations.
- Team-oriented professional with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational environment; prior leadership experience is an advantage.
- Based in Germany, preferably in Essen, with excellent English language skills; German is a plus.

You don’t meet all the criteria in the job advert, but would still like to join tk accelis? We’d look forward to getting to know you!

Your benefits

Here at tk accelis Trading, we are a highly globalised, diverse and dynamic team operating in a challenging yet exciting industry. We offer you the following benefits:

- A competitive compensation package with performance-related incentives
- A wide range of responsibilities within a highly motivated team, where you can shape your role as you see fit
- Excellent career prospects and professional development opportunities to help you progress within the company

We have caught your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application via the ‘Apply Now’ button!

Contact

Lars Wollherr
Sourcing und Recruiting
Tel: +49 152 01324580

We value diversity

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity

WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU AS

COMPENSATION, BENEFITS & PROCESSES SPECIALIST (M/W/D)

COLOGNE

Interzero is one of the leading service providers in closing product, material, and logistics cycles and a pioneer in plastics recycling, operating Europe’s largest sorting capacity. Guided by the principle of “zero waste solutions,” the company supports more than 80,000 customers across Europe in the responsible handling of recyclable materials, helping them improve their sustainability performance and conserve primary  resources. With around 2,000 employees, Interzero generates annual revenues of nearly one billion euros. According to Fraunhofer UMSICHT, Interzero’s recycling activities alone saved approximately 1.04 million tons of greenhouse gas emissions and 8.09 million tons of primary raw  materials compared to primary production in 2024. Further information at: www.interzero.de.

What is it about?

- Frameworks & Governance: You develop compensation and benefits principles, frameworks, processes and governance standards aligned with business and HR requirements.
- Compensation Processes: You manage recurring compensation and benefits processes, including salary reviews, benchmarking and remuneration analyses.
- Job Architecture: You design job architecture, grading, salary structures and related decision criteria to support internal consistency and market competitiveness.
- Data Analysis: You analyze compensation, benefits, workforce and cost data and translate findings into clear recommendations for HR and business stakeholders.
- Process Optimization: You optimize compensation- and benefits-related processes, controls, templates and digital workflows to improve quality, efficiency and transparency.
- Project Leadership: You lead cross-functional compensation, benefits and process improvement projects, including timelines, risks, deliverables and implementation.
- Stakeholder Advisory: You advise HR and business stakeholders on compensation and benefits matters, ensuring consistent application of frameworks and processes.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: You coordinate with HR Systems, Finance, Legal, Payroll and external partners to ensure compliant processes, reliable data and effective implementation.

Advantages:

- Diverse Range of Tasks: A broad and varied range of tasks awaits you, allowing you to work independently at a leading environmental service provider.
- Contribution to Company Development: You actively contribute to the further development and growth of the company, in line with our vision of a future without waste.
- Flat Hierarchies and Creative Freedom: You will encounter flat hierarchies within the company, enjoy a high degree of freedom to shape and decide and can actively contribute your own ideas.
- Flexible Working Hours: You benefit from flexible, trust-based working hours as well as the option to work remotely by arrangement.
- Attractive Benefits Package: You receive a compensation package appropriate to the position, along with modern IT equipment. In addition, you benefit from bike leasing, support for the care of family members and life-situation counseling (PME family service), corporate benefits, company pension scheme, comprehensive health management and diverse training and development opportunities

Profile:

- Education: You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business, Finance, Economics or a related field.
- Professional Experience: You bring several years of experience in compensation, benefits, grading, benchmarking or related HR processes.
- Project Management: You have a proven track record in independently managing cross-functional projects and translating data into practical solutions.
- Technical Skills: You are proficient in advanced Excel, bring strong analytical skills and sound compensation and benefits expertise.
- Communication Skills: You are fluent in German and English and comfortable presenting topics to diverse stakeholders across different languages.
- Personality: You demonstrate cooperation, initiative, entrepreneurial action, the ability to handle complexity and effective communication.

Yannick Bartsch

hr@interzero.de

Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. The university is also distinguished by its close ties to France and its strong European focus. Around 17,000 students, studying over one hundred different academic disciplines, are currently enrolled at Saarland University. Saarland University is officially recognized as one of Germany’s family-friendly higher-education institutions and with a combined workforce of more than 4000 it is one of the largest employers in the region.

The Chair of Energy Materials is inviting applications for the following position commencing at the earliest opportunity.

Doctoral Research Position (m/f/x)

Reference number W2917, salary in accordance with the German TV-L salary scale1, pay grade: E13 TV- L, duration of employment: 3 years, volume of employment: 50 % of standard working time.

Your task: Next-Generation Battery Materials for a Sustainable Future

You will dive into the synthesis and characterization of novel battery materials that go far beyond conventional lithium-ion systems. This interdisciplinary PhD project addresses central challenges of the energy transition, including alternative battery chemistries (e.g., sodium-ion, magnesium-based systems), solid-state electrolytes, and circular recycling strategies

Job requirements and responsibilities:

 Designing and characterizing novel electrode materials or electrolytes for post-Li technologies

 Advancing circular battery concepts (e.g., direct recycling, recovery of critical raw materials)

 Fabrication of battery electrodes (water-based binder systems, dry electrodes, free-standing)

 Structural and electrochemical characterization using state-of-the-art instrumentation, including X-ray diffraction,

Raman spectroscopy, and Scanning electron microscopy

 Active participation in the research activities of the group and collaboration with external partners

 Publish scientific papers and present results at international conferences

Your academic qualifications:

 Completed scientific university studies in Chemistry, Materials Science, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or related

fields

 Language skills (according to GER): English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

 Hands-on experience in electrochemistry, material characterization (e.g., XRD, SEM, BET), or process engineering

is advantageous

 Strong motivation for sustainable technologies and interdisciplinary collaboration

 Independent, analytical mindset and proficiency in English

What we can offer you:

 A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility of

teleworking

 Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions

 A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)

 An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sports

programme

 Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)

 Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)

 Job bike leasing (JobRad)

We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 09.11.2026 to ls-energymaterials-jobs@uni-saarland.de. Please include the reference number W2917 in the subject line of the e-mail.

If you have any questions, please contact us for assistance.

Your contact:

Herr Prof. Dr. Volker Presser

Materials Science and Engineering

Email: ls-energy-materials-jobs@uni-saarland.de

Pay grade classification is based on the particular details of the position held and the extent to which the applicant meets the requirements of the

pay grade within the TV-L salary scale. Part-time employment is generally possible.

If you have obtained a foreign university degree, a proof of the equivalence of this degree with a German degree by the Zentralstelle für

ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) is needed before hiring. If necessary, please apply for this in time. You can find more information at

We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, and sexual orientation and

Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration in the event of equal suitability.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Are you passionate about cardiovascular science and dedicated to ensuring patient health and safety? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Our CRM team is seeking an experienced Lead Patient Safety Physician with expertise in cardiovascular, renal, and/or metabolic diseases. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to one of Boehringer Ingelheim's priority assets in late-stage clinical development, making a meaningful impact on patient safety worldwide.
This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.
Tasks & responsibilities

- Lead, manage, and provide medical-scientific direction to a team of Patient Safety Physicians responsible for a compound/asset, including project management, project-specific guidance, team coaching, and review of team output
- Play a key role in global regulatory submissions across all regions
- Develop proactive patient-centric risk minimization strategies for assigned assets on a global scale
- Enhance the value of BI assets through robust assessment of the benefit-risk profile
- Design evidence strategies that differentiate the asset through its benefit-risk profile, considering the scientific knowledge for the molecule, medical safety landscape, population, regulatory landscape, and patient perspective
- Generate safety evidence and perform safety & efficacy analyses to support decision-making by patients, regulators, HCPs, payors, and HTA bodies
- Ensure patient safety while adhering to the highest quality and ethical standards

Requirements

- Medical Doctor with strong clinical and/or clinical research experience
- Profound experience in patient safety at a pharmaceutical company on a global/corporate level, including clinical development and post-marketing safety
- Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance regulations in major markets and the need for compliance
- Broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, and interest in future trends and developments in pharmacovigilance
- Clinical or research experience in the cardio-renal-metabolic field
- Proven leadership, people management & project management skills
- Excellent collaboration, communication, and negotiation skills
- Strong ethical sense with a quality and patient centricity mindset
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Ready to contact us? 
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until October 30th. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to September 15th are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the month of August/ beginning of September
Step 3: Panel interviews in the beginning of the month September

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Control Specification Engineer (f/m/d) for Gas Turbine Auxiliaries, you work on open-loop control and protection specifications throughout the entire lifecycle of auxiliary systems, from concept development to commissioning support. You collaborate with engineers, suppliers, instrumentation specialists, and commissioning teams to align technical requirements and ensure seamless system integration. Some days are dedicated to specification development and documentation, while others involve resolving operational challenges, supporting project teams, or addressing site issues. You work in an international environment with colleagues from diverse technical and cultural backgrounds.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for reference engineering and control specification development for gas turbine fuel systems
* Technical ownership of auxiliary systems, including control, protection, and functional performance aspects
* Coordination and clarification of interfaces with engineering teams, suppliers, commissioning personnel, and other stakeholders
* Creation and maintenance of automation specifications, parameter lists, interface documentation, and related technical documents
* Support for customer-specific engineering requirements and project adaptations
* Back-office support for site activities, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical issues

What You Bring

* Degree in mechanical engineering, process engineering, or a comparable technical field
* Professional experience in control and protection system design with knowledge of relevant engineering disciplines
* Strong analytical mindset and systematic approach to solving technical challenges
* Ability to develop practical and innovative solutions while considering implementation risks
* Strong communication and coordination skills for interdisciplinary collaboration with internal and external stakeholders
* Highly proficient written and spoken English with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

This is Worldline.

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Accountant to join our Group Accounting team in a role at the heart of our operations. You will work closely with operational teams, monitor key topics directly linked to business performance and development, and build strong relationships with PMOs and key partners across the organization.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

Working closely with the Finance department and all financial functions of the Group (Order-to-Cash teams, Business Controllers, Consolidation, Finance Management, Treasury, etc.), you will be responsible for the following tasks:

- Perform daily accounting activities: bank operations, purchases, sales, payroll, VAT, and general accounting, including analytical coding of entries.
- Process financial transactions: verification, classification, calculation, accounting and data entry.
- Prepare supplier payment runs according to deadlines (twice per month).
- Monitor and reconcile customer and supplier accounts regularly.
- Work with the FBO teams to ensure timely customer billing.
- Participate in monthly, quarterly and annual closings under IFRS and local GAAP.
- Produce regulatory reporting in accordance with local standards for tax authorities, and possibly central banks and works councils (monthly, quarterly and/or annually).
- Reconcile and justify open balance sheet items and participate in closing and balance sheet review meetings.
- Prepare and file statutory taxes: VAT, Corporate Income Tax, Environmental Taxes and other local taxes.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our global and diverse Gas Services (GS) organization, where putting the customer at the heart of every decision and continuously improving how we operate are the foundation of quality. Quality is more than reporting, firefighting, and correcting issues after the fact — it is about turning experience into sustainable learning and lasting improvement.
As Service Quality Professional you will act as a trusted partner and point of contact for our Regional Service Unit (RSU), driving important Service Quality initiatives and process improvements across GS. You will connect the Regional Service Units, Global Service Operations, and other stakeholders on key quality topics — sharing best practices, driving common standards, and creating transparency. Balancing global, strategic initiatives with selective, hands-on regional support, you will help ensure quality programs are successfully implemented and that sustainable improvements — measured by non-conformance costs (NCC) and customer satisfaction (NPS) — are achieved.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as a reliable, competent point of contact for RSU on quality topics, hurdles, and questions, ensuring RSU interests are considered in EQS decision-making.
* Enable the RSU QM community by providing the support needed to successfully implement quality programs and achieve measurable, sustainable improvements in Service Quality.
* Drive global focus-area initiatives — Customer Excellence / NPS, Service CAPA, and Process Management — in alignment with RSU needs, EQS stakeholders, and process owners.
* Support and govern prioritized improvement projects across regions, and global functions, ensuring visible, customer-felt impact.
* Foster process implementation, harmonization, and comparability of results across RSUs to reduce complexity and boost efficiency.
* Act proactively based on data — leverage dashboards, KPIs, and AI-supported insights to identify focus areas and accelerate decisions.
* Identify global, systemic issues and initiate targeted, cross-regional improvement actions, applying structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods.
* Facilitate best-practice sharing by highlighting regional successes and systematically addressing areas for improvement across the GS Service network.
* Provide transparency through structured reporting, and maintenance of relevant frameworks (e.g., Hoshin Kanri, Quality DoR)

What You Bring

* University degree in engineering, business, quality management, or a comparable field.
* Solid experience in quality management, process management, service operations, or continuous improvement, ideally within a complex, international, service-oriented organization.
* Understanding of quality methods and standards (e.g., ISO 9001), including non-conformance management, and their integration into daily processes.
* Experience applying continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, root-cause analysis) across multiple organizations.
* Affinity for digitalization and AI to make quality and process knowledge more accessible and processes smarter (e.g., SEPH, BIC Cloud, and related tools).
* Excellent stakeholder management, great communicator, and organizational skills, with the ability to build trust across cultures, regions, and hierarchy levels.
* Proactive, self-driven, and customer-centric mindset, balancing global strategic goals with pragmatic regional support.
* Fluency in English; further languages are a plus given the global scope of the role.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The following part-time (65% = 25.025 hours/week) position is to be filled as of October 1, 2026, in the Department of Epileptology of the University Hospital Bonn:

PhD Position (m/f/d)

The position is limited to 3 years.

The PhD position is focusing on pathomechanisms in autoantibody-associated neurological syndromes and autoimmune encephalitis and and supported by a grant from the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG). I will focus on the question whether (1) intracellular autoantibodies contribute causally to encephalitis, rather than acting as mere passive biomarkers and how (2) patient-derived Abs from autoantibody-positive encephalitis patients with different neurological presentations affect neuronal function using cultured neurons to assess cellular uptake, enzyme activity, neurotransmitter release and changes in neuronal plasticity.

This research is based on a wide array of methods including in vitro (e. g. Pitsch et al., 2020, PMID: 32196746) and mouse models (viral vector gene transfer/transgenic, EEG/video recordings) approaches, cell biological, molecular, biochemical, histological as well as imaging techniques (e. g. Pitsch et al., 2021, PMID: 33368582). A better understanding of the molecular and functional consequences of intracellular autoantibodies will have direct implications for better therapies aimed at interfering with autoimmune encephalitis by using pathway-specific pharmaceuticals or gene therapy.

Interested candidates should send curriculum vitae, letter of motivation indicating starting date, short description of past lab experience, copies of university degree(s) with academic records, contact information and at least two reference letters (or the referee’s contact info).

Questions concerning the projects can be addressed to PD Dr. J. Pitsch (Julika.Pitsch@ukbonn.de)

Tasks:

- - The ideal candidate will be an ambitious, highly motivated, team-oriented graduate student with a strong interest in immunology and neurobiology

Requirements:

- Prior research experience with animal experimentation, microscopy, or electrophysiology techniques is advantageous but not required.
- Candidates should hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in Neuroscience, Biological Science, Pharmacy, Veterinary Medicine, or a related field.
